slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

taking the photo

be the one who asks a stranger to take your group photo, or offers to take theirs. tiny moments of approaching people are the reps that make the big moments feel easy.

signing up early

sign up for the race, the class or the trip before you feel ready, then prepare. waiting to feel ready is just the most polite way of never starting at all.

no sorry openers

start your messages and questions without "sorry to bother you". just say hi and ask. you're allowed to take up people's time, and the right people are glad you did.

history minutes

spend 5 minutes a day on one moment in history: a revolution, an invention, a forgotten queen. people who know where things come from speak with a calm that's hard to fake.

history minutes

spend 5 minutes a day on one moment in history: a revolution, a forgotten queen. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you'll speak with a calm that's hard to fake.

slides.texte_overlay:
a class alone

join one class where you know nobody: pottery, boxing, salsa, a language. walking in alone the first time is the hard part, and it teaches you that the hard part always passes.
